name: RevenueCat subscriptions
description: Subscriptions and entitlements through RevenueCat on top of StoreKit: offerings, purchase, restore and entitlement checks, with a configuration message until the API key is set.

credentialsNeeded.description: Your RevenueCat public Apple API key (starts with appl_)

cost.note: Free below a revenue threshold, then a percentage of tracked revenue; check RevenueCat's pricing page

usage: Call `RevenueCatStore.shared.configure()` once at launch (it does nothing until REVENUECAT_API_KEY is set). Load `await store.loadOfferings()` and list `store.packages`; buy with `await store.purchase(package)`; gate features on `store.isEntitled("premium")` after `await store.refresh()`. Products are still created in App Store Connect and mapped in the RevenueCat dashboard.
statusNote: Swift compiled on a Mac in the combined compile check (see compileCheck); the module's own verify run has not passed yet: `ios-agent-mcp capabilities verify revenuecat` on a Mac.

compileCheck.scope: Template Swift and the verify usage file compiled with every other module in one app target (scripts/capability-compile-check.mjs, clean build in Xcode). Not covered: the XcodeGen project, entitlements, the widget extension target and runtime behavior.
